name: TIFA v1.0
description: TIFA is an automatic evaluation metric and benchmark that measures the faithfulness of generated images to their text inputs via visual question answering. It consists of 4K diverse text inputs and 25K questions across 12 categories, enabling fine-grained and interpretable evaluations of text-to-image generation models.
reputation: Widely used in text-to-image evaluation research as a faithfulness benchmark and automatic metric for prompt-image alignment.
notes: Reference-free metric that correlates better with human judgments than existing metrics; highlights challenges in counting, spatial relations, and composing multiple objects.
